prompt_text:
FIGURATIVE ANCIENT NARRATIVE FRESCO. The image must clearly show people or mythic beings performing a dramatic sacred action. It must NOT be an abstract pattern, textile, wallpaper, architecture-only interior, or ornamental design.

CENTRAL FIGURE: Undina, a central water-spirit woman in flowing ancient robes
CENTRAL ACTION: FREEZE first → read frozen state → validate latest-safe horizon → TOO_LATE_ABORT or close admissions
SECONDARY FIGURES: UNDINA_TIMESHIFT_AIRLOCK; Undina Native Admission Gate
SUPPORTING ACTIONS: FREEZE first → read frozen state → validate latest-safe horizon → TOO_LATE_ABORT or close admissions; THAW_TO_DRAIN while admissions remain closed
MAIN SYMBOLS: TimeShift whole-process FREEZE and the Native Admission Gate were previously capable of acting at different moments. A snapshot-to-suspend race could produce lead debt, and independent asynchronous controllers could accept stale or out-of-order acknowledgements.; write a Native Gate CLOSE/REOPEN adapter with epoch acknowledgement; admitted_total equals gate-close baseline; no gate close before sealed snapshot
EMOTION: THAWED_DRAINING
SETTING: healthy-crest frozen challenge; Persistent Wave Memory Atlas
BACKGROUND MOTIFS ONLY: Treat TimeShift and Undina as two interlocked hatches of one computational airlock: freeze and seal the chamber, close admissions while frozen, commit the horizon only after all acknowledgements, thaw only toward drain, confirm a stable vacuum valley, and then reopen exactly one new admission epoch.; tiny paired comparison scenes in a side register, subordinate to the central figures
STYLE: ancient sacred narrative wall fresco; aged lime plaster and mineral pigments; cracked weathered patina; hand-painted figurative bodies and expressive faces; dense historical storytelling with many small details
COMPOSITION RULES: one dominant central figure must be unmistakably visible; at least two secondary human or mythic figures must be visible; narrative action must dominate over ornament and architecture; figures must occupy most of the visual attention; symbols support the story rather than replace the story

Render visible bodies, faces, hands, gestures, ritual interaction, sacred objects and many small story details. Keep the central figure and central action immediately readable. Structural ideas such as replication, matrices, comparisons, segmentation, controls, epochs, validation states or uncertainty may appear only as tiny side-register scenes, reliefs, veils or distant symbols; they must never become the main composition. Preserve uncertainty visually without turning unconfirmed claims into triumphal established facts. Ancient cracked plaster, mineral pigment, hand-painted historical mural, richly detailed figurative storytelling.
